correctness.rationale: The four-point failure events split into four disjoint triangle-containment alternatives. For fixed x at radius r, q(r)=1−I(r)−3A(r)/π, with A(r)=4/(3π)(1/3+r²/2−r⁴/8+r⁶/48) from the exact pair-line Jacobian; independently verified A(0)=4/(9π), A(1)=35/(36π), and mean triangle area 35/(48π), giving Q(D)=1−35/(12π²). At r=0, I(0)=1/4 yields S(0)=1−19/(3π²)>0. For r→1, I(r)≤4√2(1−r)^(3/2)/π by the circular cap area, so q(r)−Q(D)=5(1−r)/(2π²)+O((1−r)^(3/2)), yielding S(r)<0 at r≥.99 and slope −10/π². The exact normalized-measure mixture μ=(1−h²)ν_h+h²τ_h gives S=4[Q(D)−q(r)] for each fixed center, with no uniform near-boundary moving-center error claim. Monte Carlo scripts were read but are not substituted for these proofs.
